notes.title: Discount & Mac Release!
notes.content:
Mac support & discount
We're happy to announce that Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition now supports Mac! To celebrate, the game is on discount for the first time. So if you've been holding off grabbing a copy, now's your chance :)



There's also a tiny tiny patch to 1.0.3 with a minor fix relating to Steam Stats.


Other news
While we're currently working on our next project, we do have a content update in the works for Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition.


Latest game jam
If you don't follow us on any social media (and we recommend you do), most of the team participated in our annual game jam a bit over a month ago. Check it out on Itch: https://ottersea-studio.itch.io/depth-charge



Cheers! Reid, Josh, Ciaran, & Kevin [img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3448930/extras/Hand_Want-Open.png?t=1746542726"]

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Thank you and first quick hotfix
notes.content:
Added

Achievement data failsafe in place to update Steam achievements when game is opened.



Thank you again for all the support, we're working hard on more bug fixes.

notes.title: Hello & Demo Patch
notes.content:
Hello! Firstly, thank you so much for playing the little demo of our upcoming short game, Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition. If you haven't tried it out yet, the demo features an endless mode of the game's first level, and now's a perfect time because we just fixed some bugs:

Bug Fixes

 Fixed some buttons on menu overlays not working.
 Fixed not translating to Portuguese via language selection.
 Various small bug fixes ("Not 100% sure what I did but it probably made the game better").

Please let us know if you happen upon any bugs or have suggestions on what to improve!

A bit about us
To introduce ourselves, we're a small team based in Australia and Belgium, and this is our first game we're releasing to Steam. We've participated in game jams together for some years now, combining our domains of programming (Josh), art (Reid), game design (Kevin), and music (Ciaran).
We hope you'll enjoy our little game which releases soon!

Cheers,
Reid, Josh, Ciaran, & Kevin
